title: Apartment Interior Design 90 m² in Prague | DUMSKAYA DESIGN
description: 90 m² apartment in Prague: interior design, 3D visualization, technical drawings, custom furniture and turnkey renovation.

blocks.text: Apartment interior design in Prague, custom furniture and turnkey renovation, 90 m²

parts.html: DUMSKAYA DESIGN designed and delivered a project for a 90 m² apartment in Prague, Czech Republic: interior design, technical documentation, custom furniture, and a turnkey renovation.
The project covers the living room, bedrooms, a kitchen with built-in appliances, walk-in closets, an entrance hall, bathrooms, and storage systems.

The kitchen, built-in wardrobes, walk-in closets, shelving, and storage systems were custom-made. The furniture was designed alongside the interior, so it fits precisely into the architecture of the rooms.

Before work began, the client received a detailed cost estimate covering construction and finishing work, materials, furniture, appliances, plumbing fixtures, and lighting. The studio then carried out a turnkey renovation of the apartment according to the technical documentation.
The gallery features photorealistic 3D visualizations of the project.
